propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling to 32767 but Jira Data Center's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable with range 0 to 2147483647
comments longer than hardcoded 32767 but within an admin-raised limit are silently truncated, causing permanent divergence between local and remote bodies
sanitize_comment reuses the description fitter fit_outbound, creating coupling risk where future description fitter changes silently retarget comment truncation
the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is misattributed in comments to Cloud limits when its provenance is the Jira 7.0+ default property value
whether /rest/api/2/application-properties is readable by non-admin rebar credentials is undetermined and must be tested before discovery-based remediation is feasible
